keyword.en: which concrete pumps list pipe diameter
keyword.zh: 哪些混凝土泵印了输送管径

title.en: Check valve does not replace what Pinjin Pumps Print a Delivery-Pipe Diameter lists
title.zh: 「止回阀」不能替换哪些品锦泵印了输送管内径列出的数字

description.en: Pinjin Pumps Print a Delivery-Pipe Diameter. 80 mm stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Check valve.
description.zh: 哪些品锦泵印了输送管内径。80 mm仍在目录格子里。插图来自「止回阀」。

h1.en: Check valve does not replace what Pinjin Pumps Print a Delivery-Pipe Diameter lists
h1.zh: 「止回阀」不能替换哪些品锦泵印了输送管内径列出的数字

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists a delivery-pipe diameter on only some concrete pumps in Xingtai. Electric 20 lists 80 mm. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Check_valve.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械只在邢台的部分混凝土泵上标出输送管内径。搅拌泵一体机、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 为 100 / 125 mm。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Check_valve。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Check_valve: Inconel Tilting disc check valve The Alloy Valve Stockist. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists a delivery-pipe diameter on only some concrete pumps in Xingtai. Electric 30, Electric 40, Diesel 30, Diesel 120 and LZ-80 do not list a pipe diameter. The four pages that list 100 / 125 mm still keep their own output and distance. The parts category sells pipe by confirming the pump model. The factory address for Hebei Pinjin Machinery is Renze Industrial Park, Xingtai.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Check_valve页上的Inconel Tilting disc check valve The Alloy Valve Stockist。河北品锦机械只在邢台的部分混凝土泵上标出输送管内径。标出了 100 / 125 mm 的四页仍要保留自己的产量和距离。河北品锦机械的工厂地址在邢台任泽工业园区。

body.en: Electric 20 lists 80 mm. A blank entry is not filled from a neighbouring model. B500S-83D lists delivery hose as Standard and does not list a millimetre diameter. That commercial line is not a hidden diameter for the pump sheet.
body.zh: 搅拌泵一体机、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 为 100 / 125 mm。B500S-83D 的输送胶管写的是“标准”，没有标出毫米管径。

body.en: Electric 15 lists 100–125 mm. Treat each shown diameter as page-specific. If you open Diesel 40, Electric 50 or Electric 60 and do not see a delivery-pipe row, stop. Send the model name through /en/contact/ when the concrete pump page has no diameter.
body.zh: 电动30、电动40、柴油30、柴油120和 LZ-80 没有标出管径。如果打开柴油40、电动50或电动60却看不到输送管行，就停在这里。

body.en: The integrated mixer, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60 list 100 / 125 mm. Electric 20's 80 mm does not become the default small-pump pipe, because Electric 15 lists 100–125 mm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery did not list one there. Do not assume 80 mm or 125 mm.
body.zh: 电动20的 80 mm 不是小型泵的默认管径，因为电动15标出的是 100–125 mm。混凝土泵页面没有管径时，请通过 /zh/contact/ 发送型号名称。

question.zh: 电动20标出的管径是多少？

answer.en: 80 mm. That figure is on the Electric 20 page only. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Check_valve.
answer.zh: 80 mm。这个数字只在电动20页面上。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Check_valve画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Do HBT8018 and LZ-60 list the same diameter text?
question.zh: HBT8018 和 LZ-60 的管径文字一样吗？

answer.en: Both list 100 / 125 mm. Their motors, output and distance labels are still different. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Check_valve.
answer.zh: 两边都标出 100 / 125 mm。电机、产量和距离标题仍然不同。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Check_valve画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel 120 list a pipe diameter?

answer.en: No. The Diesel 120 specification table has no delivery-pipe row. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Check_valve.
answer.zh: 没有。柴油120的规格表没有输送管行。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Check_valve画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is Standard on B500S-83D a millimetre size?
question.zh: B500S-83D 上的“标准”是毫米尺寸吗？

answer.en: No. The entry says Standard. It does not list a millimetre figure. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Check_valve.
answer.zh: 不是。这一格写的是标准，没有标出毫米数字。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Check_valve画面里印出的数字。
